source_title: How Do I Use A Payoneer Account With Etsy Payments
source_date_if_available: No date found. URL returned 403; content verified via search engine index.

snippets.snippet_text: "Etsy only supports deposits in United States Dollars (USD) to your Payoneer Payment Account. However, you can withdraw earnings from your Payoneer Payment Account to your local bank account in over 150 countries and currencies with Payoneer's bank transfer withdrawal service. Payoneer may charge a fee for this service."

"If you need to sign up for a new Payoneer Payment Account, you'll be asked to enter your personal details and upload a government-issued ID and selfie. This is done to verify your identity and your financial information to receive your sale funds."
